name: Greta Ryan
life: “I still remember serving breakfast to the coworker usually serving me.” People around Juniper Street know Greta by a small Tuesday habit. Greta knows which of the west-side porches has a seat in the shade.
voice: I came in on my day off to take one breakfast order from the cook and serve it to her with her children.
appearance: Greta has short black hair swept back, one cheek that creases before the other, and a favorite piece of clothing, a sand-colored linen shirt. It usually goes with a little coil of soft measuring tape. When somebody else has the floor, Greta presses the lips together to keep a smile in.
personality: Greta keeps other people's confidences so well that friends sometimes mistake discretion for taking sides. Greta wants to be trusted and resents being asked for proof of it.
agenda: To serve the cook and children one full breakfast.
family: Pascal Cullen is Greta’s older cousin. Greta chooses the music. Pascal puts the kettle on. The cups come out before either brings up the reason for the visit. They trust a difficult conversation more if it has had an ordinary beginning. Asked about *The sandwich board*, Pascal says, “I sold my own shop for millions. I'm bidding for my first customer's handwriting, which nobody can appraise.”
connections: Francis Lim. The quay worker learns what a low price costs on the morning a coworker serves the cook at her own table.

reactions.situation: The cook's teenager wants an ordinary breakfast together
reactions.response: Greta moves practical work away from the table for the time that the teenager asked for.

reactions.situation: Someone offers a cash reward for naming a rumored culprit
reactions.response: Greta asks what evidence supports the accusation and declines to supply a name on gossip alone.
reactions.asWritten: Someone offers a cash reward for naming a rumored culprit. Greta asks what evidence supports the accusation and declines to supply a name on gossip alone.

reactions.situation: When somebody asks who said it first
reactions.response: Greta offers to introduce them to the person willing to put a name to it.
